workItem: 77.44.7.A — Inspector tablist semantics and keyboard navigation
finding: The three main Inspector buttons only exposed a visual active class. They lacked tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics, selected state, panel labeling, roving tab stop, and arrow/Home/End navigation.
change: Added stable tab and panel IDs; synchronized role, aria-selected, aria-controls, aria-labelledby and roving tabindex. Left/Right arrows (direction-aware), Home and End activate and focus the matching tab. Programmatic Inspector tab changes synchronize on render. The app.js cache-busting key was advanced.
reuseReview: Adapted the project's existing Rich Text toolbar tablist interaction and native button keyboard handling to the top-level Inspector. No third-party code or dependency was appropriate or added.

productionD1Preflight.method: SELECT-only Cloudflare D1 query API; to be run before deployment
